blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A bus driver initially tested positive in a drug screening at the Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) on Wednesday as authorities stepped up safety measures ahead of the All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day holidays. The driver, assigned to a bus bound for Bicol, was referred for confirmatory testing in accordance with screening procedures, PITX said. A total of 251 drivers underwent drug screening at the terminal in preparation for the expected surge in passenger traffic during the All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day or Undas.
